title: PulseStep force mode ring trail for elevation prompts
desc: PulseStep.Line() and Finish() always emit to stderr regardless of WKAPPBOT_PROFILE flag. Ring trail keeps last 20 lines for UAC context.
steps: PulseStep.Line() calls Emit(force=true) -- bypasses WKAPPBOT_PROFILE=1 check and 100ms threshold. Always prints to stderr.
Ring trail: last 20 emitted lines stored in LinkedList with lock. GetRecentTrail(n) returns newest-last slice for UAC/elevation context.
Usage: PulseStep.Init sets up session keyed by CallerMemberName. Mark() records checkpoint. Done() prints total. Line() forces output.
author: claude
